text:
Guest post by Jenn Baker, CondemnedUSA.com A funny thing happened on the way to the insurrection… For over four years, the Mainstream Media has vilified the January 6th defendants as the worst of the worst, Insurrectionists, traitors, cop beaters, and an endless amount of other slanderous names. The MSM would have you believe there was a “plan” by protesters that day. The legacy media wanted you to believe that there were groups of people who planned to overthrow the government and “stop the peaceful transfer of power” on January 6. The media would have you believe that the ultimate BoogeyMen of January 6th were the leaders of “right wing extremist groups” Oath Keepers and The Proud Boys. Oath Keepers Founder, Stewart Rhodes and Proud Boys Chairman, Enrique Tarrio , according to the MSM, plotted their efforts and planned the “single worst day” in American history. In the trials of Rhodes and Tarrio, it was mentioned that they had met the night before January 6th in a parking garage in Virginia. According to each of the prosecutions, this meeting was to solidify the plan of Insurrection. Although there was never a plan, and not one of the almost 1,600 J6 defendants was ever charged with Insurrection, the MSM tried to make the narrative stick. “THE BOOGEYMEN OF J6”, Rhodes and Tarrio, never met before arriving at the parking garage in Virginia. Their groups had occasionally worked in tandem at different rallies and protests. Both groups were there to protect the American people from leftist thugs, BLM, and Antifa. However, this so-called meeting in the garage would be their first. Enrique had been released from jail before the 6th and was not allowed in DC at the time. He had been arrested for allegedly burning a BLM flag. His legal representation at the time, Kelly Sorelle, was meeting him at a parking garage just outside of DC. She had been receiving death threats and had Stewart Rhodes and other Oath Keepers with her as security. When they arrived at the garage, Stewart and Enrique shook hands, exchanged pleasantries and then separated to give Tarrio his privacy with his attorney. Pictures and video were taken and from there the narrative was written. This last week Stewart was asked to be on the “WE ARE GOOD MEN” Rumble LIVE podcast. Proud Boy and commutated J6 Hostage Ethan Nordean, in enjoying a cross-country trip from Seattle, Washington, to Florida. He stopped at J6ROADHOME.com on Thursday and had a jam-packed livestream. Just by happenstance the guest after Stewart was to be Enrique. Nordean brought Enrique up to the screen and bowed out to allow the “BOOGEYMEN” to have their time. Watch: The interview starts at the 50:00 mark. In this interview, we learn how this is actually only the second time they have seen each other in real-time. They spoke about how the corrupt DOJ used lies and liars to prove their cases against the Proud Boys AND the Oath Keepers. Then we hear about what actually happened in that parking garage. Enrique was one of the over 1,500 pardoned J6 defendants, whereas Stewart was one of 14 who were merely commuted. With appreciation and relief that he was released from prison on the early morning of January 21st, Rhodes is left wondering why his sentence was commuted and why he did not receive a pardon. Payment System – Orders IMMEDIATE Destruction of ALL Data Obtained Since Trump’s Inauguration – Musk Responds to Ruling with Fire The 14 whose sentences were commuted are all members of either the Proud Boys or Oath Keepers. Some were found guilty of Sedition/Seditious Conspiracy and some were not. There is no apparent rhyme or reason as to why their sentences were only commuted, and there are many theories. Some believe it is so Pam Bondi and the DOJ will study the egregiousness of their cases and take appropriate action against those who brought them about, and then they will receive their full pardons. We will see what comes to pass, but until then, we will continue to see these amazing Patriots tell their stories and hear how they will be stepping up to make a difference in this world. Tarrio has announced that he will be making a run for Congress in either 2026 or 2028. Rhodes has joined up with J6er Treniss Evans as a Spokesman for Condemned USA. He will be bringing attention to and helping the politically persecuted and fighting to make necessary changes in the Bureau of Prisons as well as the Department of Justice. There is much to be done, and these men are on the path to make change happen. If you would like to follow Enrique on X you can find him here @NobleOne.
